newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish end-May EBR 17 mln punts - Finance Dept.
newsitem.headline: Irish end-May EBR 17 mln punts - Finance Dept.

text.p: Ireland's end-May Exchequer Borrowing Requirement (EBR) totalled 17 million Irish pounds versus 632 million in the same period in 1996, the Department of Finance said on Wednesday.
Total tax receipts were 5,436.16 million punts compared with 4,676.17 million at end-May 1996, the Department of Finance said.
Miscellaneous revenue was 84.96 million and other receipts came to 52.99 million versus 88.69 million and 62.07 million respectively in the same period last year.
Central fund issues totalled 1,212.61 million versus 1,228.13 million and supply services were 4,545.66 million versus 4,344.88 million, the finance department said.
Other issues came to 8.4 million versus 22.77 million Irish pounds in the five months ended May 1996.
